summary: Sanders Co., MT ground site on Lolo NF: camp 1907, cab 1914, cupola cabin 1928; cabin gone by 1965, debris below the summit sign (2010).

notes_for_editor: Fate conflict: the FFLOS entry says the site was deserted by 1965 while firelookout.com says the cabin was destroyed in 1965; no third source found, so both are reported. Staffing names come from newspaper transcriptions on montanalookouts.weebly.com (secondary). The 2010 and 2015 items are personal trip reports, not Forest Service records; the 2010 post was read on the live blog because the archive mirror returned 403. WebSearch found no 1965 detail and only a generic Lolo NF reference. No official trail or closure status was checked. The record's built 1928 matches the FFLOS Built field, which refers to the cupola cabin; the earlier 1907 camp and 1914 cab are included in the events.
